_doc: Chapter leadership as of the current board & POC directory. Names and roles only — the source document also carries home addresses, personal phone numbers, personal emails, spouse names and VVA member numbers, none of which are reproduced here or anywhere on this site.

committees.name: Vacant
committees.review: Stan Derr, the chapter's longtime web manager, has died. This role is vacant and needs a new owner.

committees.name: Vacant
committees.review: Tom Stryer has resigned from this role, per the chapter's 2026-08-17 board & POC directory. See REVIEW.md 2.4 — the legacy site's only call to action for this program was already broken, and now there is no coordinator to fix it toward. The chapter needs to name a successor.

committees.name: Bob Tecklenburg
committees.review: The legacy site spells this “anniversity” and never says which 50th. The chapter's own 50th falls in 2035, so this is probably the Vietnam War 50th Commemoration.

review: The 2026-08-17 board & POC directory lists one person, James (Jim) Ellett, with no title filled in (every other entry says "Director" or "Contact"). He is a 2025 National delegate per the same document, but is left off this roster until the chapter confirms his role rather than guessing.
notable: The chapter's ranks have run from privates to a three-star general and an admiral. Admiral Zumwalt remained a member after moving to North Carolina.
